Chapter 01 — Biography

Poetry with a modern pulse.

Krishna Kanth (KK) is one of Telugu cinema's most celebrated lyricists, known for blending poetic elegance with raw, modern emotion. His words have become the soul of many unforgettable songs, reaching listeners across the globe.

From intimate love ballads to powerful anthems, his range is extraordinary. He captures the emotional core of a story in carefully chosen words, which has made him the go-to lyricist for some of Tollywood's biggest directors and composers.

The heartbreak of a soldier, the longing of separated lovers, the fire of a warrior's resolve: KK's lyrics breathe life into every frame and note.

Poetic depth

Rich metaphors and layered meaning in every line

Emotional range

Romance, action, inspiration and beyond

Mass appeal

Songs that resonate with millions worldwide
